tools.name: transcripts
tools.description: List the sub-agent runs of a profile, newest first, or the sessions. Each line gives the exact path to pass to transcript and the full messages.jsonl file path, with size and time of last activity.

path.description: What to list: profile:<category>/<name> (or profile:<session>/<category>/<name>) for the sub-agent runs of one profile; sessions for the sessions; remote:<name>/session:<id> (or remote:<name>) for a remote JAD server's sessions and remote:<name>/profile:<session>/<category>/<name> for its runs, only when allow_remote is on. The profiles of a session are listed by the profile tool (action list).

filters.description: Only items whose name matches every filter, case-insensitive. A filter with * or ? is a wildcard pattern (dev*, *coder); any other is a substring. For runs the agent name and the parent call id are matched too.

status.description: Only sub-agent runs in this state. Only with a profile: path.

limit.description: Most items in this response; capped by the configuration.

cursor.description: Continue where the previous response stopped; use the cursor it gave. Not with path, filters or status.
